import numpy as np

# Reference orientations
Q0_OPEN_X = np.array([0.0, 0.707, 0.707, 0.0])   # arm0 down, fingers close along X (grasp handle lying along Y)
Q0_OPEN_Y = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0])       # arm0 down, fingers close along Y (hammer rotated to lie along X)
Q1_OPEN_Y = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0])       # arm1 down, fingers close along Y (grasp handle lying along X)

HANDOVER_Z = 0.175        # required 0.15-0.20
HANDOVER_X0 = 0.76        # arm0 grasp point, slightly on arm0's side of the midpoint (0.81)
GRIP_SEP = 0.085          # >= 8cm buffer between grippers along X
HANDOVER_X1 = HANDOVER_X0 + GRIP_SEP
TRAVEL_Z = 0.32

# --- Setup: open grippers, park arm1 out of the way ---
open_gripper_arm0()
open_gripper_arm1()
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([1.05, 0.0, TRAVEL_Z]), Q1_OPEN_Y)

# --- Arm0 grasps the handle, biased toward the head end so the +Y part of the handle stays free for arm1 ---
hpos, _ = get_hammer_pose()
grasp0 = np.array([hpos[0], hpos[1] - 0.03, hpos[2]])
goto_pose_arm0(grasp0, Q0_OPEN_X, z_approach=0.12)
close_gripper_arm0()

# --- Lift straight up ---
lift = np.array([grasp0[0], grasp0[1], max(hpos[2] + 0.22, TRAVEL_Z)])
goto_pose_arm0(lift, Q0_OPEN_X)

# --- Rotate wrist 90deg about vertical: Q0_OPEN_X -> Q0_OPEN_Y is a -90deg world yaw,
#     so the handle (+Y) now points toward +X (toward arm1), head toward -X (arm0's side) ---
goto_pose_arm0(lift, Q0_OPEN_Y)

# --- Translate at travel height to above handover point, then lower to handover height ---
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X0, 0.0, lift[2]]), Q0_OPEN_Y)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X0, 0.0, HANDOVER_Z]), Q0_OPEN_Y)

# --- Arm1 approaches from above and grasps the handle, 8.5cm further along +X than arm0's grip ---
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([HANDOVER_X1, 0.0, TRAVEL_Z]), Q1_OPEN_Y)
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([HANDOVER_X1, 0.0, HANDOVER_Z]), Q1_OPEN_Y, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper_arm1()

# --- Release and retreat arm0: up first (fingers open along Y so they clear the handle), then back toward -X ---
open_gripper_arm0()
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X0, 0.0, HANDOVER_Z + 0.15]), Q0_OPEN_Y)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([0.50, 0.0, TRAVEL_Z]), Q0_OPEN_Y)
